title: The exact amount of t-ness that the normal model can tolerate
summary: Suppose that the normal model is used for data $Y_1,\ldots,Y_n$, but that the true distribution is a t-distribution with location and scale parameters $ξ$ and $σ$ and $m$ degrees of freedom. The normal model corresponds to $m=\infty$. Using a local asymptotic framework where $m$ is allowed to increase with $n$ two classes of estimands are identified. One small class, which in particular contains the functions of $ξ$ alone, is only affected by t-ness to the second order, and maximum likelihood estimation in the two- or three-parameter models become equivalent.
